hud-bstmy.5.6.title: Decide: delete the never-activated freeze, or keep and wire it (invariant 3)
hud-bstmy.5.6.description:
Escalation (hard gate: amends invariant 3 wording, docs/invariants.md). One decision.

Facts: SharedState.freeze_active (protocol session.rs:191) is never set true outside tests (session_server tests.rs:2251). runtime shell/freeze.rs (1,137 lines) is referenced only by re-exports and 3 portal integration tests (text_stream_portal_{coalescing,cadence,governance} import FreezeQueue). The protocol freeze queue (session_server/freeze_queue.rs 217; mutations.rs:345-~420; mod.rs:413-426) can never fill. Invariant 3 currently covers safe mode and dismiss; freeze is described alongside.

Options:
A. Delete freeze (runtime shell/freeze.rs, protocol freeze queue, freeze_active) and reword invariant 3 to 'Safe mode and dismiss'. About -3,000 lines. Lands after T7 (hud-lirh2) retargets the portal tests.
B. Keep and wire it: a viewer chord/hotkey freezes agent mutations (queued, applied on unfreeze), drawn in chrome; add a behavior test. About +300 lines.
C. Status quo: leave dead code as is.

Recommendation: A. No current user, the POC Override criterion is satisfied by safe mode (hud-jm8nq.10), and 'prefer deleting over generalizing'. Consequences: A shrinks invariant 3 scope (no freeze promise); B adds a feature the vision does not require; C keeps 3k dead lines and a misleading invariant claim.

Default if unanswered: C (status quo, no code or invariant change).

hud-bstmy.5.7.title: Reconcile spec-to-code (gen-1) for T8.2b: Decided changes in runtime shell, widgets, telemetry and examples
hud-bstmy.5.7.description:
Deep-dive review: compare the original spec/requirements (see epic description and docs/scope.md T8 row, docs/invariants.md) against the implementation delivered by sibling beads under this epic.

Mindset: audit the CODEBASE against the spec, not the sibling diffs against their bead descriptions. Your job is to FALSIFY the coverage claim, not to collect confirming evidence. A requirement counts as implemented only after you have read the implementing code; a test existing or the suite being green is never sufficient evidence by itself.

Workflow:
1. Re-read the epic description and all sibling bead descriptions/acceptance criteria.
2. Audit the code. Start from the sibling diffs, but treat the whole codebase as in scope; spec invariants bind pre-existing code too.
3. For every universal or negative requirement ("no X anywhere", "every Y must", "the only path is Z"): enumerate ALL code paths performing that operation (search the repo) and verify each one.
4. Audit the instruments: for every guardrail/scan test, read its regex, glob and scan roots and check they cover the mandated surface. For every spec scenario confirm ONE gate pins it (a behavior-executing test, or the designated scan guard for structural invariants).
5. Where several surfaces implement the same contract, diff them against each other (filters, defaults, ordering, authz).
6. Produce a checklist mapping every requirement to its implementing bead and code evidence (file:line), classified implemented/partial/missing/deviates.
7. For every partial or missing requirement, report a cold-start-ready gap candidate in Discovered-Follow-Ups-JSON (priority, parent, deps, exact spec link, acceptance evidence, gate species, expected net test delta).
8. When gaps remain, report the need for a gen-2 reconciliation and return blocked-awaiting-coordinator with "coverage gaps remain" as the unblock condition.
9. The coordinator dedupes/materializes gaps and closes lifecycle state; this worker never mutates Beads lifecycle.
hud-bstmy.5.7.design: Spec sources: docs/scope.md T8 row and Working rules, docs/invariants.md (every named test exists), docs/vision.md, plus every sibling bead under hud-bstmy.5 (their Files/Evidence lists define the deletion surface; verify each deletion grep is empty and each kept test exists). Runs last among implementation siblings. Escalation (needs-human) siblings are deliberately NOT dependencies: their default is status quo, so reconciliation must not wait on an owner answer; if one was answered, include its follow-up bead.
hud-bstmy.5.7.acceptance_criteria:
1. Every requirement in the epic spec has a corresponding implementation bead.
2. Universal/negative invariants are verified by enumerating every code path that performs the operation, not by citing a single compliant example.
3. Guardrail/scan tests were audited for blind spots, and every spec scenario is pinned by exactly one gate species; no gap candidate proposes tests for a scenario that already has one.
4. Any gaps found are reported as dedupe-ready child-bead candidates under the same epic.
5. If gaps were found, the handoff reports a next-generation reconciliation candidate.
6. The close reason records the reconciliation summary.
